title: Kanban Board — visual/manual rubric
setup: npm install; npm run dev. Open TWO browser windows. Create a few cards first.

items.criterion: Drag-and-drop works with the mouse: card can be picked up, dragged across columns, and dropped at a chosen position (not only appended).
Optimistic UI: the dragged card lands instantly on drop (no visible wait for the server), and does not flicker or snap back when the move succeeds.
Convergence: after moves in both windows (including moving the SAME card in both), both windows settle to the identical order; no duplicate or lost card.
Robustness: dropping a card outside any valid target leaves the board intact (card returns; nothing disappears).
Layout: columns side by side, card text readable, no overlapping or clipped elements at a normal desktop width.
